Happiness

해피니스

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2021

⭐⭐⭐⭐☆1000/10

Overview

Set in a near future where a deadly infectious disease spreads throughout South Korea, Happiness follows police officer Yoon Sae-bom and detective Jung Yi-hyun, who move into a newly built apartment after entering a contract marriage. When residents begin turning into infected, bloodthirsty people, the entire apartment complex is placed under lockdown. As fear, selfishness, and survival instincts emerge, the residents become more dangerous than the infected themselves.

My Review

I say, even the kindest person would be cruel sometimes, especially in situations where lives are at stake. I love the chemistry of Yi-hyun and Sae-bom. Their relationship felt natural and they always trusted each other no matter what happened. The series was really good, but I think the ending was too rushed. It didn't reveal much about what happened after the lockdown ended. I think the title is Happiness because the disease was called Mad Person Disease. HAHAHAHA. Yi-hyun was so handsome. I'm okay if he bites me. HAHAHAHA.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Yi-hyun and Sae-bom protecting each other throughout the lockdown. • Every moment where Yi-hyun risked his own life to save Sae-bom. • The residents slowly revealing their true personalities during the quarantine. • The final battle against the infected inside the apartment.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"Getting an apartment is important, but who you're with is more important."
